name: cardealership-frontend

scripts.test:profile: npm run test:profile-validation && npm run test:profile-service
scripts.test:password: npm run test:password-validation && npm run test:password-change
scripts.test:admin-chat: npm run test:admin-chat-state && npm run test:admin-chat-socket && npm run test:admin-chat-api && npm run test:admin-chat-badge && npm run test:admin-chat-security && npm run test:admin-chat-accessibility && npm run test:chat-interaction && npm run test:chat-persistence
scripts.test:chat-persistence: npm run test:chat-api && npm run test:chat-history-merge
scripts.test:chat-interaction: npm run test:admin-reply-workflow && npm run test:typing-indicator
scripts.test:regression: npm run test:auth && npm run test:protected-route && npm run test:auth-persistence && npm run test:profile && npm run test:password && npm run test:booking-history && npm run test:booking-availability && npm run test:availability-selection && npm run test:vehicle-filters && npm run test:api-config
scripts.test:sprint7: npm run test:admin-chat && npm run test:regression
scripts.test:sprint7-release: npm run test:sprint7 && VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://approved-production-api.example.com VITE_PROFILE_MOCK_MODE=false VITE_AVAILABILITY_MOCK_MODE=false VITE_CHAT_GATEWAY_URL= VITE_CHAT_TRANSPORT=mock VITE_CHAT_MOCK_MODE=false VITE_CHAT_API_MOCK_MODE=false npm run build
scripts.test:listing-wizard: npm run test:listing-wizard-state && npm run test:listing-wizard-validation
scripts.test:dispatch-domain: npm run test:booking-transitions && npm run test:dispatch-state
scripts.test:dispatch-live: npm run test:dispatch-api && npm run test:dispatch-synchronization && npm run test:dispatch-domain && npm run test:dispatch-interface
scripts.test:sprint8-validation: npm run test:listing-accessibility && npm run test:dispatch-accessibility && npm run test:sprint8-security
scripts.test:sprint8-targeted: npm run test:listing-wizard-state && npm run test:listing-wizard-validation && npm run test:listing-image-selection && npm run test:listing-upload-adapter && npm run test:listing-submission && npm run test:dispatch-state && npm run test:booking-transitions && npm run test:dispatch-api && npm run test:dispatch-synchronization && npm run test:listing-accessibility && npm run test:dispatch-accessibility && npm run test:sprint8-security
scripts.test:sprint8-regression: npm run test:regression && node backend/tests/carPayloadValidation.manual.js && npm run test:image-optimization-contract && npm --prefix backend run test:car-image-cleanup
scripts.test:sprint8-full: npm run test:sprint8-targeted && npm run test:sprint8-regression

description: Panda Motors car dealership web application
